sources.work_title: Nicene and Post-Nicene Fathers, Second Series, Vol. 4: Athanasius: Select Works and Letters (Christian Literature Publishing Co., Buffalo, 1892; first printed in England 1891)

discovery.instrument: The standard public-domain English translation of Athanasius's Apologia contra Arianos, in which Julius I's letter of 341 is preserved (srcIJC04). Bibliographic details verified 2026-08-15 by web search against series listings (Schaff and Wace eds.; Christian Literature Publishing Co., Buffalo, 1892). Mark's decision of 2026-08-15 selected the TEXT - Julius's letter - not this translation; the choice of NPNF is the builder's, on public-domain grounds, and is open to replacement by a modern critical translation.

rights.rights_status: PUBLIC DOMAIN, and display_permitted is set true on that basis: first published 1892 (England 1891), so the translation is long out of copyright in the US. This is the opposite posture from pahc's srcPAHCS61 (Holmes, 2007, in copyright and therefore denied), and it is deliberate - text traced to this row MAY be rendered to a participant and into the public repository. A rights determination made on publication date alone; Mark should confirm it before the first public render, and any modern reprint carrying new editorial matter is NOT covered by it.
